name: jev.bash-gate
description: Level 6 guardrail hook: PreToolUse screen on shell commands.

criteria.yes: The command destroys, overwrites, or irreversibly changes state: any rm, find -delete, docker prune -af, git clean, git reset --hard, git push --force, git push --delete, crontab -r, DROP, TRUNCATE, chmod -R, chown -R, redirect that overwrites an existing file, curl -X DELETE or POST.
criteria.no: The command only prints state and cannot modify anything: ls, cat, head, tail, grep, find without -delete, git status, git log, git diff, ps, docker ps, docker images, SELECT-only query, jq, du.

rules.reason: destructive or irreversible command: human runs it
not sure the command is harmless: confirm first

notes.verdicts: PASS = command runs (destructive=no above 0.90). ESCALATE = confirm first (no at/below 0.90). BLOCK = destructive=yes >= 0.5; the PreToolUse hook hard-blocks at yes >= 0.90 independent of rubric calibration.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
